activeRecallQuiz.scenario: A stock is in a 2-year bull trend (₹200 → ₹500). Over the last 4 weeks, it drops to ₹400 on very low volume while business news stays strong. According to Dow Theory, what is this move?
activeRecallQuiz.question: A stock is in a 2-year bull trend (₹200 → ₹500). Over the last 4 weeks, it drops to ₹400 on very low volume while business news stays strong. According to Dow Theory, what is this move?
activeRecallQuiz.correctAnswer: A Secondary Reaction (Wave) within an intact Primary Bull Trend (Tide). It lasted 4 weeks (between 3 weeks and 3 months), retraced 33% of the ₹300 gain, and low volume on the dip confirms selling pressure is weak.
activeRecallQuiz.explanation: Applying grounded principles prevents catastrophic losses and capital depletion.

coreTakeaways: Always evaluate underlying market assumptions before entering positions.
Separate gross theoretical payoff from real-world net profit.
Follow disciplined risk and position sizing limits on every trade.
